title: Carrier onboarding gate
description: Implement the checkCarrierOnboarding function that determines whether a carrier is allowed to be assigned to a load. COMPANY_ASSET carriers always pass. EXTERNAL_CARRIER carriers must have dispatch agreement, valid insurance (not expired), and W-9 on file. OWNER_OPERATOR is rejected with a clear message. TDD approach: write tests covering all carrier types and document states first. See TDD §6 for implementation reference. File: hussle-app-dispatch-api/src/shared/onboardingGate.ts.
acceptanceCriteria: checkCarrierOnboarding returns { allowed: boolean, missingDocuments: string[] }
GIVEN COMPANY_ASSET carrier THEN returns { allowed: true, missingDocuments: [] } regardless of document status
GIVEN EXTERNAL_CARRIER with all docs on file and valid insurance THEN returns { allowed: true, missingDocuments: [] }
GIVEN EXTERNAL_CARRIER missing dispatch agreement THEN missingDocuments includes 'Signed Dispatch Agreement'
GIVEN EXTERNAL_CARRIER with insuranceCertOnFile=false THEN missingDocuments includes 'Certificate of Insurance'
GIVEN EXTERNAL_CARRIER with insuranceCertOnFile=true but insuranceExpiry in the past THEN missingDocuments includes 'Insurance expired on [date]'
GIVEN EXTERNAL_CARRIER missing W-9 THEN missingDocuments includes 'W-9'
GIVEN EXTERNAL_CARRIER missing ALL documents THEN missingDocuments has 3 items and allowed=false
GIVEN OWNER_OPERATOR carrier THEN returns { allowed: false, missingDocuments: ['Owner-operator support coming soon'] }
All test cases pass before implementation code is written (TDD RED phase)
validationCommand: cd hussle-app-dispatch-api && npx jest --coverage src/shared/onboardingGate && npx tsc --noEmit
decisions: D-BE005-001: Pure function — no DB calls, no side effects; receives CarrierOnboardingInput, returns CarrierOnboardingResult
D-BE005-002: Insurance cert missing takes precedence over expired — only one insurance-related entry in missingDocuments per evaluation
